The '''Broken Cliff''' sept is a sept of the [[Daryne]] [[Aiel]] and the sept of it's [[Clan chief]], [[Mandelain]]. It is only mention in [[The Wheel of Time Companion]]. We know neither its location not the location of the lands of the Daryne Aiel generally.
